title: Density changes Tech View row, avatar and bar sizes, not Board card avatars
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run).
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "DC-06-tech-view-compact-light-1440.png" and "DC-06-tech-view-regular-light-1440.png" and "DC-06-tech-view-comfortable-light-1440.png" attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and the rank numbers in the pictures are sample data.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST C590128 Density" has an Approved work order, unit "C590128-U1", led by technician "ZZAUTOTEST C590128 Ana", with a service advisor and line technician "ZZAUTOTEST C590128 Ben" on its approved line; Board View's "Fields to display" has "Line technicians" on.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, "Search" holding "ZZAUTOTEST C590128 Density", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, density "Regular".
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the density button and choose "Compact".
  2. Look at the rows, the group headers, the avatars and the progress bars, and compare them with the Compact picture.
  3. Click the density button and choose "Regular".
  4. Look at them again and compare them with the Regular picture.
  5. Click the density button and choose "Comfortable".
  6. Look at them again and compare them with the Comfortable picture.
  7. Click "Board View" in the display switcher and click the density button.
  8. Look at the avatars on the card for unit "C590128-U1".
  9. Choose "Compact" in the density menu.
  10. Look at the avatars on the same card.
custom_expected:
Step 1: "Compact" is the density in use.

Step 2: as in the Compact picture: the rows are at their lowest (36 px in the design), row avatars and the Service Advisor avatar 20 px, group header avatars 24 px, progress bars 48 × 4 px; the same columns and values show, the row text keeps its size and no hours line shows under the bar.

Step 3: "Regular" is the density in use.

Step 4: as in the Regular picture: rows 48 px, row and Service Advisor avatars 24 px, group header avatars 28 px, progress bars 64 × 6 px; the same columns and values show and no hours line shows.

Step 5: "Comfortable" is the density in use.

Step 6: as in the Comfortable picture: rows 64 px, row and Service Advisor avatars 32 px, group header avatars 36 px; the same columns and values show, no hours line shows, and the header labels and the percentage keep their small size.

Step 7: the density menu opens with "Comfortable" in use in Board View too.

Step 8: the card's avatars are 24 px.

Step 9: "Compact" is the density in use.

Step 10: the card's avatars are the same size as at step 8 (24 px).

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on the Work Orders QA build
